result.instructions: Tools for APITemplate.io, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which PDF and image templates do I have saved?"; "How much of my monthly PDF quota have I used so far?"; "Show the last 10 PDFs I generated and when each was made.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes APITemplate.io data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run apitemplate_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run apitemplate_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run apitemplate_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. apitemplate_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: apitemplate_get_account
tools.title: Get account and quota
tools.description: The APITemplate.io account behind this key: plan, subscription status and period, and the quota: api_quota, api_used, api_remaining (generations), plus the template quota and count. Check api_remaining before generating. GET /v2/account-information.

tools.name: apitemplate_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the templates of the account (PDF and image): template_id, name, format (PDF or JPEG), status, group and dates. Use the template_id with the create tools. Read-only; templates are never changed. GET /v2/list-templates.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Next page: offset + limit.

format.description: Only PDF or only image (JPEG) templates.

template_id.description: The template id (apitemplate_list_templates, or the web console, Manage Templates).

tools.name: apitemplate_get_template
tools.title: Get PDF template source
tools.description: One PDF template's HTML body, CSS and print settings (the vendor marks this endpoint experimental, so it can answer with an error for some accounts or image templates). Read-only. GET /v2/get-template.

template_id.description: The template id (apitemplate_list_templates, or the web console, Manage Templates).

tools.name: apitemplate_list_objects
tools.title: List generated files
tools.description: List the PDFs and images generated so far, newest first: transaction_ref, template_id, type (PDF, JPEG or MERGE), your meta reference, the hosted file URLs (primary_url, secondary_url for the PNG) and dates. Files already deleted or expired have deletion_status set. Read-only. GET /v2/list-objects.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Next page: offset + limit.

template_id.description: Only files generated from this template.

tools.name: apitemplate_create_pdf
tools.title: Create a PDF from a template
tools.description: WRITE: renders one PDF from a saved PDF template and your JSON data (the keys the template uses, e.g. invoice_number, items), and returns the hosted download_url (never the file bytes). Synchronous. COST: uses 1 generation of your APITemplate.io plan quota per call (see apitemplate_get_account). Do not retry or repeat it unless needed; every call is counted. POST /v2/create-pdf (export_type=json).

template_id.description: The template id (apitemplate_list_templates, or the web console, Manage Templates).

data.description: JSON data merged into the template, e.g. {"invoice_number":"INV-1","total":42}. Keys depend on the template.

filename.description: Custom file name ending in .pdf (default: a random UUID).

expiration.description: Minutes until the hosted file expires: 0 = keep permanently (default), or 1-10080.

meta.description: Your own reference id for this file; it shows up in apitemplate_list_objects.

output_html.description: Also return html_url, the rendered HTML.

generation_delay.description: Milliseconds to wait before rendering (0-30000), for pages that load content late.

annotations.title: Create a PDF from a template

tools.name: apitemplate_create_image
tools.title: Create an image from a template
tools.description: WRITE: renders one image (JPEG and PNG) from a saved image template, changing the named layers with overrides (e.g. [{"name":"text_1","text":"Hello"},{"name":"image_1","src":"https://..."}]), and returns the hosted download URLs (never the file bytes). COST: uses 1 generation of your APITemplate.io plan quota per call (see apitemplate_get_account). Do not retry or repeat it unless needed; every call is counted. POST /v2/create-image.

template_id.description: The template id (apitemplate_list_templates, or the web console, Manage Templates).

name.description: Layer name in the template, e.g. text_1.

overrides.description: Layer changes: each item has the layer 'name' and the properties to set (text, src, color, textBackgroundColor ...).

expiration.description: Minutes until the hosted file expires: 0 = keep permanently (default), or 1-10080.

meta.description: Your own reference id for this file; it shows up in apitemplate_list_objects.

generation_delay.description: Milliseconds to wait before rendering (0-30000), for pages that load content late.

annotations.title: Create an image from a template

tools.name: apitemplate_create_pdf_from_html
tools.title: Create a PDF from HTML
tools.description: WRITE: renders one PDF from HTML (Jinja2 placeholders like {{name}} are filled from data), without a saved template, and returns the hosted download_url (never the file bytes). COST: uses 1 generation of your APITemplate.io plan quota per call (see apitemplate_get_account). Do not retry or repeat it unless needed; every call is counted. POST /v2/create-pdf-from-html (export_type=json).

body.description: HTML body; may use Jinja2 syntax such as {{name}}.

data.description: Values for the placeholders in body, e.g. {"name":"Jo"}.

paper_size.description: Paper size; 'custom' needs custom_width and custom_height.

custom_width.description: Width for paper_size custom, with a unit (mm, px or cm), e.g. 210mm.

custom_height.description: Height for paper_size custom, with a unit (mm, px or cm), e.g. 297mm.

margin_top.description: Top margin, e.g. '40' (the vendor reference says mm).

preferCSSPageSize.description: Let the CSS @page rule set page size and orientation (engine 153 only).

filename.description: Custom file name ending in .pdf (default: a random UUID).

expiration.description: Minutes until the hosted file expires: 0 = keep permanently (default), or 1-10080.

meta.description: Your own reference id for this file; it shows up in apitemplate_list_objects.

generation_delay.description: Milliseconds to wait before rendering (0-30000), for pages that load content late.

tools.name: apitemplate_create_pdf_from_url
tools.title: Create a PDF from a web page URL
tools.description: WRITE: APITemplate.io opens one public web page URL and prints it to a PDF, and returns the hosted download_url (never the file bytes). The page is fetched by APITemplate.io, not by this server; pages that need a login cannot be printed. COST: uses 1 generation of your APITemplate.io plan quota per call (see apitemplate_get_account). Do not retry or repeat it unless needed; every call is counted. POST /v2/create-pdf-from-url (export_type=json).

tools.name: apitemplate_merge_pdfs
tools.title: Merge PDFs
tools.description: WRITE: joins 2-20 PDFs (public http(s) URLs, in the given order, e.g. earlier download_url values) into one PDF and returns the hosted primary_url (never the file bytes). The source files are not changed or deleted. COST: uses 1 generation of your APITemplate.io plan quota per call (see apitemplate_get_account). Do not retry or repeat it unless needed; every call is counted. POST /v2/merge-pdfs (export_type=json).

urls.description: The PDF URLs to join, in order.

expiration.description: Minutes until the hosted file expires: 0 = keep permanently (default), or 1-43200.

meta.description: Your own reference id for this file; it shows up in apitemplate_list_objects.
